title: Paper v2 portfolio and run-console HMM runtime omit explicit coefficients_path
description:
Expected: Paper v2 Selection, portfolio creation, run-console, historical replay, and live session should use the same platform HMM coefficient artifact selection contract. When HMM is enabled, the runtime config should either carry an explicit coefficients_path or persist a backend-resolved coefficient artifact so Selection and Paper v2 execution use the same HMM coefficients. HMM must remain platform runtime state and must not be bound into StrategyPackage.
Actual: Selection page explicitly passes runtime_profile.hmm.coefficients_path and documents that this avoids stale/ambiguous coefficient use, but portfolio creation only sends model_snapshot_id/signal_preset and run-console only sends coefficients_path when manually typed. Backend HMM runtime can fail when multiple coefficient artifacts cover a trade_date and explicit coefficients_path is missing, or Paper v2 may use a different coefficient artifact than Selection.
reproduce_command: rg -n "coefficients_path|selectedHmmArtifact|runtimeProfileConfig|runtimeHmmCoefficientsPath|multiple HMM coefficient artifacts cover trade_date" frontend/src/app/paper-v2/selection/page.tsx frontend/src/app/paper-v2/portfolios/page.tsx frontend/src/app/paper-v2/portfolios/[portfolioId]/run-console/page.tsx backend/services/selection_center/hmm_runtime.py -S
required_verification: Regression test: Selection, portfolio creation, run-console readiness/day-run, replay, live session, and runtime-profile save all send or persist runtime_profile.hmm.coefficients_path when HMM is enabled and a covering coefficient artifact exists.

Regression test: HMM enabled with no coefficient artifact covering the relevant trade date or replay date range fails before API submission with a readable UI error; backend ambiguous auto-resolution is not used as the normal Paper v2 UI path.
Regression test: historical replay date ranges validate coefficient artifact coverage for the full requested range, not only the first date, when covered_trade_dates are available.
Regression test: HMM remains platform runtime configuration and is not written into StrategyPackage frozen manifest or StrategyPackage-bound runtime state.
Frontend validation: TypeScript and affected Playwright/API payload checks pass without relying on mock-only success as the sole proof for the business path.
Design-compliance review: produce a DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 matrix mapping issue expectations to implementation refs and test/evidence refs before marking BUG-076 fixed.
closure_requirements: BUG-076 local JSON and GitHub issue #103 remain synchronized for status, fix branch, labels, verification evidence, and closure comments.

No root worktree pollution: all BUG-076 code, tests, validation records, and BUG registry edits are committed on bug/BUG-076-paper-v2-hmm-coefficients-path or an explicitly approved integration branch.

No simplified/subset/POC/placeholder/mock-only implementation is claimed complete; all issue-required Paper v2 paths are either fully implemented and verified or explicitly reported as blockers before merge.
A validation record under tests/aistock_validation/history/paper_v2 records commands, results, residual risks, production-port impact, and the design-compliance matrix.
Production backend 8001, frontend 3000, production DB, HMM snapshots, StrategyPackage manifests, and protected model artifacts are not modified during validation unless explicitly approved.
